3STRUCTURAL WORKS | 2025–2026
01.
Structural modelling and verification
4-storey classroom building
Type  -  Educational

The project is a 4-storey classroom building with a roof deck, budgeted at ₱80M. I was tasked with its structural modeling and verification.

Using ETABS as the primary software, I cross-referenced the model with STAAD.Pro to eliminate design anomalies and ensure structural reliability.

Through this dual-software approach I evaluated soft-storey, mass and torsional irregularities and P-delta effects, giving a code-compliant, optimized design for the project's budget and safety requirements.

  • Peak P-Δ stability index 0.028 (limit 0.10)
  • Mass ratio max 1.06 (limit 1.5)
  • Soft-storey Ki/Ki+1 min 0.96 (limit 0.7)
  • Torsion Y: Δmax/Δavg 1.268, Ax 1.08–1.11

02.
Hip truss roof system
School auditorium, Tacloban
Type  -  Educational

For the school auditorium I designed the critical hip truss system of the third-floor sports court, within a project budgeted at about ₱150M.

The truss spans roughly 30 m × 45 m inside a 33 m × 71 m footprint. It was analyzed in STAAD.Pro for a design wind speed of 290 km/h.

Double angle bars balance high lateral loads against cost, giving a cost-efficient yet robust roofing framework against typhoon loads.

  • Software: STAAD.Pro
  • Design wind: 290 km/h
7STRUCTURAL WORKS | 2025–2026
School auditorium · foundation and canopy
Mat foundation: reactions into SAFE
Front canopy: ETABS model
8STRUCTURAL WORKS | 2025–2026

Mat foundation. Reactions were extracted from the superstructure model and exported to SAFE to design a heavy-duty mat, checked for uplift, punching shear, sliding, overturning and soil settlement under all load combinations.

Front canopy. The 8.94 m high canopy is carried by only two columns, so large eccentricities govern. It was modeled in ETABS and supported on an isolated footing with strap beam, designed in SAFE for uplift and overturning.

05.
Isolated foundation
Hazardous waste warehouse and office, Tacloban
Type  -  Industrial / mixed-use

I was responsible for the foundation design of a mixed-use, 2-storey building with a hazardous waste warehouse connected to a 2-storey office.

Reaction data from the superstructure model was imported into SAFE to design the isolated foundation system.

Given the hazardous waste storage, the substructure was evaluated for long-term serviceability, with strict settlement and deflection controls.

  • Software: SAFE

10.
RC design and detailing
Mausoleum, General Trias, Cavite
Type  -  Memorial

A reinforced concrete mausoleum about 4 m high with a roof slab and a front canopy.

Designed to NSCP 2015 and ACI 318 for a 250 km/h design wind, seismic Zone 4 and an allowable soil bearing capacity of 143 kPa.

Detailed with isolated footings, footing tie beams, columns and beams, and a two-way roof slab with an RC canopy.

  • Columns and beams: 200 × 300 mm
  • Isolated footings: 900 × 900 × 300 mm
